evidence.coverage_rule: Reapply depth to each original run, then rebuild biological and cell means; frozen model scores are unchanged.
evidence.retained_position_comparison: For each cell pair and higher read cutoff, compare primary and current excess on their coordinate intersection; separately count retained, lost and newly qualifying positions. Empty comparisons retain zero counts and unavailable contrasts.
evidence.example_stability: Keep the primary discovery-selected transcript, cell pair and coordinate list fixed; report retained positions at each depth.
evidence.confirmation_summary: One highest-discovery-magnitude comparison per gene, taken from the full discovery ranking; zeros and reversals do not retain direction.
evidence.annotation: Same fixed Ensembl 91 reference as the model; zero-based half-open intervals; stop codons precede CDS in region assignment.
evidence.region_background: Positions observed in every declared biological replicate before the score cutoff, and the subset in shared-candidate genes. Counts are transcript positions, not unique genomic bases.
evidence.region_gene_weighting: For each candidate gene, multiply its candidate count by its eligible-position 3-prime UTR fraction, then sum; dividing by total candidate count gives a background with the same gene contributions.
evidence.candidate_turnover: Loss of observation in any declared biological replicate is a coverage loss; a fully observed baseline candidate below the score cutoff is a score loss. Both use the same score cutoff as the baseline.
evidence.individual_confirmation: For the three discovery-selected examples, retain each remaining biological-replicate pair, its available original positions and signed mean contrast; sample pairs can share replicates.

scope: Context-aware trees: 23 of 23 declared processed runs, 7 cell lines, 17 biological replicates.
coordinates: Original input keys are retained in per-run prediction tables. Analysis maps only explicitly verified transcript version aliases to the fixed reference IDs, preserving input_transcript_id and input_transcript_position; analysis positions use canonical integer strings and matched seven-mers must agree.

transcript_aliases.audit: Exact version headers and full sequences match the fixed Ensembl 91 reference. Unlisted IDs remain unchanged.

human_rule: ENST transcript IDs. SIRV, ERCC and R1_/R2_ sequin IDs are synthetic; other nonhuman IDs are separately counted.
aggregation: Mean available eligible technical runs at each coordinate, then mean available biological replicates. No coverage weighting or missing-to-zero imputation. Support counts accompany every aggregate.
depth_comparison: Primary matched_replicates comparisons require at least two biological replicates per cell and a maximum/minimum biological-replicate mean read-depth ratio no greater than 2 across both cells.
matched_variation: At each matched position, average absolute differences over all cross-cell biological-replicate pairs. Within each cell, average all distinct biological-replicate pairs, then give the two cells equal weight. Average both quantities over the same positions.
shared_positions: Same transcript coordinate and seven-mer, with at least two observed biological replicates in every cell. Shared candidates additionally require all declared biological replicates and every replicate score at least 0.5.
examples: Use matched_replicates positions with a score in the lowest-numbered biological replicate of each cell (discovery) and at least one remaining replicate (confirmation). Require at least 3 qualifying positions per transcript. Rank the absolute signed mean discovery contrast, then site count; select 3 distinct genes without using confirmation scores in ranking. Confirmation is the equal mean of remaining replicates at each same position. All candidates and qualifying positions are saved.
interpretation: Scores predict binary m6A site labels; they are not molecular modification fractions. Technical runs are grouped within biological replicates. Hct116 replicate 3/run 1 overlaps Dataset 0 training measurements.
